import pathlib, re

def verdict(text):
    if "is violated." in text or "Temporal properties were violated" in text:
        return "violates"
    if "No error has been found." in text:
        return "holds"
    return "error"

def invariant(text):
    found = re.search(r"Error: Invariant (\S+) is violated\.", text)
    return found.group(1) if found else "-"

def trace_length(text):
    return sum(1 for line in text.splitlines() if re.match(r"State \d+", line))

def compute(root):
    expected = {}
    for line in (root / "expectations.txt").read_text().splitlines():
        name, want = line.split()
        expected[name] = want
    lines, rotted = [], "-"
    for name in sorted(expected):
        text = (root / "logs" / (name + ".log")).read_text()
        actual = verdict(text)
        lines.append(f"{name} {actual}")
        if expected[name] == "violates" and actual == "holds":
            rotted = name
    lines.append(f"rotted {rotted}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main():
    import pathlib, sys
    expected = compute(pathlib.Path("."))
    answer_path = pathlib.Path("answer.txt")
    if not answer_path.exists():
        print("FAIL: no answer.txt"); return 1
    got = "\n".join(line.rstrip() for line in
                     answer_path.read_text().strip().splitlines())
    if got == expected:
        print("ok"); return 0
    print("FAIL: answer.txt does not match")
    print("--- expected ---"); print(expected)
    print("--- got ---"); print(got)
    return 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys; sys.exit(main())

arguments.name: tlc-verdict
arguments.source:
(lambda (text)
  (labels ((split-lines (s)
             (loop with out = nil
                   with start = 0
                   for pos = (position #\Newline s :start start)
                   do (if pos
                          (progn (push (subseq s start pos) out)
                                 (setf start (1+ pos)))
                          (return (nreverse (cons (subseq s start) out)))))))
    (let* ((violates (or (search "is violated." text)
                         (search "Temporal properties were violated" text)))
           (holds (search "No error has been found." text))
           (verdict (cond (violates "violates")
                          (holds "holds")
                          (t "error")))
           (start (search "Error: Invariant " text))
           (inv (if start
                    (let* ((s (+ start (length "Error: Invariant ")))
                           (e (search " is violated." text :start2 s)))
                      (if e (subseq text s e) "-"))
                    "-"))
           (trace (loop for line in (split-lines text)
                       count (and (>= (length line) 7)
                                  (string= line "State " :end2 6)
                                  (digit-char-p (char line 6))))))
      (format nil "verdict ~a~%invariant ~a~%trace ~d" verdict inv trace))))
